name: @w6w-apps/bitly
description: Shorten, manage and track Bitly links via the Bitly REST API v4.

w6w.longDescription:
Bitly turns link management into a workflow step — shorten a URL, look one up, update its destination, and pull click analytics, all through Bitly's REST API. Actions cover creating and updating Bitlinks, expanding a short link back to its original destination, and listing an account's Bitlinks by group, alongside summary and detailed click reporting for tracking how a link performs over time.

A list-groups action rounds out the set, since Bitly scopes link listing to one group at a time and every account needs at least its default group's ID to use the others.

This is a focused slice of Bitly's link and analytics surface: it does not manage custom domains, campaigns or bulk operations, keeping the footprint to the core loop of shortening, tracking and updating the links a workflow actually needs to touch.
